summary: Orders delivered within 30 days are refunded in full. The refund is prepared automatically but always executed by a human.
Billing disputes are investigated by the billing team; adjustments are issued as account credit, not as refunds.
Technical faults are fixed, not refunded. A refund is only considered after support has failed to resolve the fault.
Account and access problems carry no refund entitlement.
Uncategorised requests have no policy of their own and are read by a human.
